question: Does staging accepted pleural pressure as an external load on the registered thoracic compartments produce an actual vascular response in the fast coupled native scene?
arms: accepted previous-step pleural pressure added to immutable regional baseline
common_setup: Matched 12 s rest, active Brain control, same reference skin, regional compression and capsule. Drive multiplier .6 from 4 to 8 s in both arms.
interpretation: An external pressure load changes transmural pressure; the phase-dependent response is computed by the compiled filling/ejection network. No uniform sensitivity sign is assigned to each chamber at arbitrary phase. This test cannot establish feedback from vascular deformation to lung mechanics or active 3D vascular tissue.
